name: Kettlebell Iron Cross
description: Also called the crucifix. With a straight arm, raise the bell out to the side to shoulder height, arm parallel to the floor in a 'T' — a straight-arm lateral hold that lights up the whole shoulder and the stabilizers holding the bell out on a long lever. Keep the shoulder packed DOWN (not shrugged), ribs down, and don't let the arm bend to cheat the leverage. Brief hold or controlled raise-and-lower. A big straight-arm shoulder load — go light, and back off if the shoulder complains.
